# @mission-platform/scheduler-core

Framework-agnostic scheduler core for Mission Platform. It holds the **single
implementation** of the heavy, framework-independent calendar logic that both
the Vue `@mission-platform/components` `ForgeScheduler` (via `useScheduler`) and
the write-once `@mission-platform/components` `ForgeScheduler` consume, so the
two frameworks stay in parity by construction rather than by duplication.

It is a pure-TypeScript package (no Vue, no React) built straight to ESM + types
with `vite` + `tsc`. Its only runtime dependencies are `luxon` (date math) and
`nanoid` (event UIDs).

## Exports (`@mission-platform/scheduler-core`)

### RFC 5545 (iCalendar) model + view types (`src/types.ts`)
- `VEvent` (the RFC 5545 VEVENT record — `uid`/`dtstart`/`dtend`/`dtstamp` +
  descriptive/classification/participation/recurrence/alarm fields), `RRule`
  (`freq`/`interval`/`count`/`until`/`byday`/`bymonthday`/`bymonth`/`bysetpos`),
  `RRuleFreq`, `RRuleWeekday`, `VEventStatus`/`VEventClass`/`VEventTransp`,
  `VEventAttendee`, `VAlarm`.
- `SchedulerView` (`day`\|`three-day`\|`week`\|`month`\|`year`), `WeekStart`
  (0=Sun…6=Sat), `SchedulerEventSlot` (`{ event, column, totalColumns }` for the
  time-grid layout), `DateRange` (`{ start, end }`).

### Date helpers (`src/dates.ts`)
- `isAllDay`, `parseDT`/`parseDate`, `fmtLike` (format back to the source's
  all-day vs timed shape), `dayKey`, `startOfDay`/`startOfWeek`/`startOfMonth`/
  `startOfYear`, `addDays`/`addMonths`/`addYears`, `WEEKDAY_LUXON`.

### Recurrence expansion (`src/recurrence.ts`)
- `expandRecurrences(event, rangeStart, rangeEnd)` — expand a recurring `VEvent`
  into the concrete occurrences overlapping `[start, end)`, honouring RRULE
  (FREQ/INTERVAL/COUNT/UNTIL/BYDAY/BYMONTHDAY/BYMONTH), RDATE, and EXDATE; each
  occurrence carries `recurrenceId` + `masterUid`. Safety-capped at 3650 steps.

### View range + navigation (`src/range.ts`)
- `visibleRangeFor(view, anchor, weekStartsOn?)` → `DateRange` — the visible
  window for a view.
- `stepAnchor(view, anchor, direction)` — step the anchor ±1 view unit
  (day/three-day/week in days; month/year in their period).

### Event selectors, mutations, duration & layout (`src/events.ts`)
- `eventsForRange(events, start, end)` / `eventsForDay(events, day)` — select
  visible events (expanding recurrences, excluding `CANCELLED`).
- `createEvent(partial)` (uid + timestamps), `applyEventPatch(event, patch)`
  (bumps `lastModified`/`sequence`), `moveEventPatch(event, deltaMs)`,
  `resizeEventPatch(event, deltaMs)` (clamps to a 15-min / 1-day minimum).
- `formatDuration(event)` → `"1h 30m"`.
- `layoutDay(events)` → `SchedulerEventSlot[]` — column-collision layout for the
  time grid.

## Consumers
- `@mission-platform/components` — `forge-scheduler`'s `use-scheduler.ts` wraps
  these pure helpers with Vue reactivity (`ref`/`computed`), and `types.ts`
  re-exports the model; the time-grid view uses `layoutDay`. Its existing 900+
  line spec stays green as the parity baseline.
- `@mission-platform/components` — `ForgeScheduler` consumes these helpers
  directly with the neutral hooks (multi-view grids + recurrence).
